"Negative, Captain. I calculate that this will be my only opportunity to end the Clone Wars as I planned. With a victory for the Separatist Alliance.|Captain Rex and General Kalani|}} In [[2 BBY]], [[Captain]] [[Rex]] and the [[Spectres]] undertook a '''mission''' to the [[planet]] [[Agamar]] to obtain [[proton bomb]]s from a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel|supply ship]]. However, they were captured by a [[Agamar garrison|holdout]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] by still-functioning [[battle droid]]s led by the [[ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|super tactical droid]] [[Kalani]]. The [[droid]] general wished to end the [[Clone Wars]] on his own terms, and challenged the rebels to a battle that would decide the victors, taking [[Garazeb Orrelios]] hostage. Led by Rex, [[Ezra Bridger]] and [[Kanan Jarrus]] eventually managed to overpower the droids and confront Kalani, but [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] forces suddenly arrived and attacked the Separatist [[Unidentified DH-Omni Support Vessel (Agamar)|supply ship]]. The rebels and droids came to the conclusion that the Empire was the real victor of the Clone Wars, and decided to unite to get a victory of their own. They used the droids to distract the Imperial forces like their [[All Terrain Armored Transport (Prototype)|AT-AT]] [[walker]]s in order to cripple them with proton bombs, which allowed them to escape in several Separatist [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttles]]. The Spectres kept [[Phantom II|their shuttle]] as a replacement for their lost [[shuttle]], the ''[[Phantom]]''. ==Prelude== {{Quote|The Jedi betrayal ended the war for most of the galaxy. But here on Agamar, I assumed it was a Republic trick and prevented the shutdown command.|Kalani|}} In [[20 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars]], Republic-backed rebels led by [[Steela Gerrera]] and her brother, [[Saw Gerrera|Saw]], launched a [[Onderonian Civil War|campaign]] against King [[Sanjay Rash]] of [[Onderon]], who was aligned with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatists]], and the occupying Confederate droid forces on the planet.{{TCW|A War on Two Fronts}} As the rebels continued to mount attacks with the aid of the [[Jedi]], Separatist [[Head of State]] [[Count]] [[Dooku]] deployed General Kalani to Onderon with droid reinforcements in hopes of quelling the unrest.{{TCW|Front Runners}} However, as the Confederate reinforcements failed to bring down the rebels, Dooku ordered Kalani to execute Rash and withdraw all remaining Separatist forces to Agamar,{{TCW|Tipping Points}} where they remained for nearly 20 years. After the [[Executive Separatist Council|Separatist leaders]] were [[Mission to Mustafar|slaughtered]] by [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] in the aftermath of the Clone Wars, all Separatist [[battle droid]]s were to be shut down.{{Film|III}} However, the [[ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|super tactical droid]] [[Kalani]] assumed that the shutdown of the droids and [[Order 66|extermination of the Jedi]] was just a [[Galactic Republic]] trick, and avoided the shutdown along with the droids under his control. In [[2 BBY]], the ''[[Ghost]]'' [[Spectres|crew]] received information about a [[Unidentified DH-Omni Support Vessel (Agamar)|destroyed]] [[Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel|Separatist supply ship]] on [[Agamar]] from [[Rex]], and they traveled there in order to gain the ammunition left behind, especially [[proton bomb]]s. [[Kanan Jarrus]], [[Ezra Bridger]], [[Garazeb Orrelios]] and the [[astromech droid]] [[C1-10P|Chopper]] accompanied Rex, while [[Hera Syndulla]] and [[Sabine Wren]] departed to handle other business. ==The last battle== ===Blast from the past=== {{Quote|We have new orders, incapacitate and capture. Activating stunner.|B1-268 apprehends the intruders|}} The rebels entered the transport ship and uncovered a large supply of proton bombs in the hangar, but as they were about to collect them, they were entrapped by a [[ray shield]]. They were then surrounded by Separatist battle droids, who mistook the rebels for Republic troops and prepared to shoot them. However, they immediately received orders to stun and capture the rebels instead, and they did so. Chopper, who had deviated from his allies' path, remained free and unnoticed in the hangar. [[File:Battle_droid_squad_six.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Squad Six (Agamar)|Squad Six]] assisted in the capturing of the rebels.]] Rex, Bridger, Jarrus, and Orrelios awoke in the command center, where they came face to face with the Separatist super tactical droid Kalani. Kalani revealed to the rebels how he and his troops were still functioning and told them about his desire to end the Clone Wars with a Separatist victory, despite the rebels telling him that the Clone Wars had ended. The droid general threatened to terminate them if they refused to participate. Orrelios, upon refusing to participate in the battle, was informed by Kalani that he would be playing the hostage in the battle situation, as his species, the [[Lasat]], had not participated in the Clone Wars. Jarrus and Rex refused to fight the droids, but Bridger agreed, on the conditions that Orrelios would be released and they would gain possession of all the proton bombs if they won, which Kalani agreed to. Jarrus and Rex begrudgingly agreed to participate, and the battle preparations began. Meanwhile, Chopper found a [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]] in the hangar and sent a distress signal to the ''Ghost''. However, the ''Ghost'' was being pursued by Governor [[Arihnda Pryce]] and Agent [[Alexsandr Kallus]] in several [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyers]], fleeing with a quantity of stolen [[fuel]], and the Imperial fleet intercepted the signal. Chopper's signal was encrypted, but Pryce recognized it as a rebel distress call and had forces sent to Agamar. ===Reenacting the Clone Wars=== {{Quote|No... the war. It's not over!"
"Rex!"
"Cody!"
"Talk to me!"
"Ah, Kanan, I'm sorry, I thought you were someone else|Rex waking up from being stunned|}} On Agamar, Rex, Jarrus, and Bridger returned outside as Kalani laid out the conditions for the battle: the three rebels would have to fight their way to his command center in order to rescue Orrelios. If the rebels captured the command center, they would win. Jarrus chose Rex to lead them into battle due to his combat experience, and Rex told them that since they were heavily outnumbered, they would have to attack the hangar aggressively. As the battle droids approached, the rebels adopted a sword and shield formation, where Jarrus and Bridger blocked the droids' blaster bolts with their [[lightsaber]]s in order to give Rex cover to throw [[Thermal detonator|detonators]] at the droids. The rebels managed to push through the droids as they took refuge in the hangar, and they seemed to face no opposition after that. However, this was all part of Kalani's tactics, and when the rebels went out into the open, Kalani sent [[droideka]]s onto the crosswalks above the hangar to fire at them. Overwhelmed by the droidekas, Bridger got the idea to attack them with a nearby crane while Rex and Jarrus drew their fire away. They split up, and Rex and Jarrus resumed their attack on the droidekas, though Rex was wounded in the right shoulder. Meanwhile, Bridger ran into Chopper, who told him about the Separatist shuttle. Bridger then used [[the Force]] to ram the crane into the bridges, causing the droidekas to fall and break. Bridger reunited with Jarrus and Rex, but Rex was angry at Bridger for not executing their plan efficiently. The rebels exited the hangar into the halls of the ship, where they were surrounded by two droidekas. Jarrus managed to [[Force push]] one of them, causing it to malfunction and destroy itself. The other one managed to graze Bridger, but Rex threw his helmet at it, causing its shields to fall and allowing the clone to destroy it with a [[blaster]] shot. The rebels reflected that the droids were not as durable as they used to be due to their age. ===The real Clone Wars victors=== {{Quote|I know the Jedi were wiped out, the clones were decommissioned and the droid army was just shut down. The Clone War ended but why? If none of you won, who did?''"
"''Uhh the Empire.|Ezra and Zeb|}} [[File:Ezra_reasoning_with_Rex_and_Kalani.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ezra convinces Rex and Kalani to make peace.]] The rebels entered the command center and prepared to claim victory, but Kalani was not about to honor it as he claimed that his droids would have won if they were in peak condition. Rex prepared to shoot the droid, but Bridger stopped him, having realized that neither the Republic nor the Separatists really won the Clone Wars. As Imperial forces arrived on Agamar, Bridger realized that the two sides had been decimated by the true victors: the Empire. Some of Kalani's battle droids greeted arriving [[stormtrooper]]s at the front of the ship, but were easily dispatched. Bridger proposed an alliance between the two sides to fight against the Imperial platoon, convincing Kalani's programming that the Empire, as an extension of the Republic, was his enemy as well, and the two sides agreed. Bridger created a plan to escape on the ''Sheathipede''-class shuttles that Chopper had found, but the problem was that the remaining battle droids were too depleted to battle the Empire, and the shuttles had no weapons. However, the rebels had the idea to attack the Imperial [[All Terrain Armored Transport]] walkers with the proton bombs they came for. Due to the battle droids' aim not being accurate enough to set off the bombs, they would instead fire at Jarrus and Bridger, who would redirect the blaster shots toward the bombs. The rebels and the Separatists moved to the hangar, and Orrelios led the battle droids in direct combat against the [[All Terrain Defense Pod]] walkers, which the droidekas managed to heavily damage. While this happened, the [[B1-series battle droid]]s rolled the proton bombs at the AT-ATs, and Jarrus and Bridger redirected the shots they had fired at them, successfully setting off the bombs and destroying one of the AT-ATs. In the midst of the chaos, the rebels boarded one shuttle while Kalani and the remaining battle droids boarded the other two, although the shuttle occupied entirely by battle droids was shot down. The remaining two shuttles managed to fly through the Imperial platoon and successfully escape into space. ==Aftermath== {{Dialogue|Rex|No, it was a victory. We all just won the Clone War, and you ended it Ezra. A galaxy of senators couldn't do that. An army of Jedi, clones, and droids couldn't find the middle ground, but you did.|Ezra|Rex, all I did was point out that none of you were meant to win. You couldn't.|Rex|And we needed to hear it.|Kalani|Agreed. I am satisfied if you are, Captain.|Rex|I am.|attr=Rex, Ezra Bridger, and Kalani bring an unofficial end to the Clone Wars|src=}} [[File:Rebels_and_Rex_part_as_friends_with_Kalani.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kalani parting with Rex and his rebel companions as friends]] The two ships entered space, where the ''Ghost'' had just arrived to pick up the rebels. Kalani at first stated that while they had escaped, it had not been a victory. Rex disagreed however, and stated that they had all just ended and won the Clone Wars. He thanked Bridger for this, and both Rex and Kalani accepted this as the true end of the Clone Wars. Due to calculating a low chance of success of defeating the Empire, Kalani and his forces parted ways with the rebels. Kanan contacted Syndulla, who was shocked to hear that they had not gained any proton bombs, but Jarrus told her that instead they had gotten a new [[Phantom II|''Phantom'']]: the shuttle they were currently piloting. ==Appearances== *''[[Legends of the Alliance]]'' {{Mo}} *{{Rebels|The Last Battle}} {{1st}} *{{Rebels|Imperial Supercommandos}} {{Imo}} ==Sources== *{{HelmetCollectionCite|64|Highlights of the Saga}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|65|Databank A-Z}} {{Imo}} *''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' {{Imo}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|agamar|Agamar}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{CanonGCW}} {{Interlang |es=Misión a Agamar (2 ABY) |ja=アガマーの任務 }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Agamar (2 BBY), mission to}} [[Category:Battles of Agamar]] [[Category:Missions of the Galactic Civil War]]
